newsitem.title: UK: UK Coryton cracker restart delayed to Friday.
newsitem.headline: UK Coryton cracker restart delayed to Friday.

text.p: The restart of BP/Mobil's 60,000 barrels per day (bpd) catalytic cracking unit at its U.K. Coryton oil refinery has been postponed until Friday, a company spokesman said.
The company originally hoped for a restart early this week.
"There have been one or two little problems along the way and we hope to have it restarted on Friday," the spokesman said of the shutdown which began six days ago.
One of two catalytic crackers at Shell's Pernis site in Rotterdam went down last week for a month, to be followed by a two-month scheduled maintenance outage.
The BP/Texaco 55,000 bpd catcracker at Nerefco's Europoort refinery shut down on Friday too, but was back in operation on Monday.
